output.summary: Deciduous or evergreen trees, shrubs and woody climbers native to warm-temperate and subtropical areas worldwide. They are typically armed and have alternate divided leaves. Several species provide spices, notably Sichuan pepper, whose compounds produce characteristic numbness.
output.edibilityNote: Several species provide spices; examples include the fruit husks of Z. armatum and Z. bungeanum, ground to make Sichuan pepper.
